summary: Operator site: confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups, pull-through sites, laundry; added Wi-Fi at RV sites. Its rates page shows 'starting at' $40-60 a night (undated; winter from $47); fees left as the dated Campspot read of 2026-10-13 ($45-107.50). The site also offers long-term stays for snowbirds by application, alongside nightly Campspot booking, so the long-stay tests pass. Note unchanged (waterslide closure still posted).
